learning_outcomes.text: Shape a flat table so it can drive PivotTables and PivotCharts reliably
Build PivotTables and PivotCharts that refresh from a single source
Add slicers and connect them to multiple visuals for interactivity
Design a one-screen dashboard layout that answers the stated questions
Review AI-suggested chart and layout choices before publishing

integrative_case: A sales operations analyst must deliver a monthly dashboard: reshape the export into a flat table, build refreshable PivotTables and PivotCharts, add connected slicers and a timeline, lay everything out on one screen around the questions managers ask, and review the AI-suggested visuals against the source data.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
